items.title: STAT+: ARPA-H launches $160 million effort to develop custom gene editing drugs
items.summary: An ARPA-H program to jump-start custom gene editing treatments was delayed by a change in administrations. Now seven labs will get sizable grants.

items.title: Prime 贏得基因編輯爭議； Saol 聲稱最新的 Makary 美國食藥局（FDA） 逆轉

items.summary: Vertex claimed the two drugs in the deal could eventually bring in more than $5 billion annually. Still, the high price it paid stirred debate among analysts and investors.
